events.verdict: Harris (DEN) briefly engages and disengages with Towns (MIN) after going around the pick.
Jokic (DEN) makes incidental "high-five" contact with Covington's (MIN) hand after he has released the ball.
Towns (MIN) and Millsap (DEN) briefly engage with one another on the rebound.
Towns (MIN) makes marginal contact with Millsap's (DEN) body that does not affect his shot attempt.
[Observable in enhanced video] Towns (MIN) lifts his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Millsap (DEN) is not established in a legal guarding position prior to the start of Towns's (MIN) upward shooting motion and is still moving at the time of the contact.
Teague (MIN) moves laterally into Murray's (DEN) path during his drive and affects his SQBR.
Towns (MIN) and Millsap (DEN) briefly engage and disengage prior to the inbound pass.
Covington (MIN) makes marginal contact with Jokic's (DEN) body that does not affect his shot attempt.
Millsap (DEN) makes incidental contact with Towns (MIN) that does not affect his SQBR.
Towns (MIN) makes contact to Murray's (DEN) hand, affecting his ability to pass the ball.
Wiggins (MIN) makes marginal contact to Jokic's (DEN) arm at the end of his drive.
Gibson (MIN) makes marginal contact with Millsap's (DEN) body that does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Towns (MIN) commits a take foul on Murray (DEN).
Teague (MIN) briefly extends his arms out in front of him while setting the screen on Plumlee (DEN) during the inbound.

Harris (DEN) makes contact with Towns's (MIN) arm during the follow-through on his jump shot but does not affect his ability to follow-through naturally.
